name: B10-0217/2025 (S&D) – Targeted attacks against Christians in the Democratic Republic of the Congo – defending religious freedom and security
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the targeted attacks against Christians in the Democratic Republic of the Congo: defending religious freedom and security
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its position on violence in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, where armed groups have attacked civilians, including Christians and church leaders. It calls for an immediate ceasefire, for the M23 rebels to withdraw, for humanitarian aid to reach people safely, and for those who commit atrocities, including sexual violence, to be held accountable. It also urges a return to political talks.

- No law changes; Parliament only states its position and makes requests.
- Affects civilians in eastern Congo, aid workers, and armed groups and governments involved.
- Next: the text is sent to the EU's foreign policy chief, the Council, the Commission and Congolese authorities.
